people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Nebo_Mount
people.line: The mountain where Moses viewed the Promised Land

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go up this mountain of the Abarim range and see the land that I have given the Israelites.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mountain of Abarim, and behold the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
